publishedRecipe.name: Breaded Pork Chop with Curry Roasted Cauliflower & Apple-Raisin Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and separate cauliflower into bite-sized florets; cut stems into smaller pieces and transfer to a large baking sheet pan. Drizzle with oil, then season with curry powder and salt; toss to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium head cauliflower
4 tsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp curry powder
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until cauliflower is fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, place bread crumbs and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup panko bread crumbs
1 tsp turmeric, ground
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat pork chops dry with paper towels, place on a plate, and spread both sides with mayo. Sprinkle bread crumb mixture over both sides and press to adhere.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chops and pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate, loosely cover with aluminum foil, and set aside.
Meanwhile, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a medium bowl; whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tsp apple cider vinegar
½ tsp salt
⅛ tsp cayenne pepper
⅛ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, quarter, and core apples; cut into matchsticks or coarsely grate. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with raisins, and toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 Granny Smith apples
½ cup raisins

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide chops, cauliflower, and apple salad between plates; enjoy!
